About Me

Data at the heart of
public health.

I'm a Senior Health Information Officer with the Ghana Health Service, based in Jomoro Municipal, Western Region. My work sits at the crossroads of health systems and data — collecting, validating, and transforming facility-level data into intelligence that supports district health management decisions.

Over 5 years, I've developed a deep technical skillset that goes well beyond traditional HIO work. I write automation scripts, build interactive dashboards, create geospatial maps, and design data pipelines — because I believe that better tools mean better data, and better data means better health outcomes.

I'm equally committed to knowledge sharing — training fellow health information officers, simplifying complex workflows, and building tools that teams can use. I am particularly interested in opportunities where strong information systems, reliable data and practical analytics can strengthen health programmes.

My professional interests include routine health information systems, data quality improvement, digital health, health programme monitoring, geospatial analysis and evidence-informed decision-making. I enjoy translating operational questions into clear analytical outputs for technical and non-technical audiences.

HEALTH SYSTEMS · DATA MANAGEMENT 5+ years of experience

Senior Health Information Officer

Ghana Health Service · Jomoro Municipal, Western Region, Ghana

Supporting the collection, validation, management and use of facility-level health data to inform district health management and programme decisions.

  • Support routine health information management and reporting processes, including work with DHIMS2.
  • Promote data quality through review, validation and follow-up on facility-level reporting.
  • Develop practical automation and analytical tools to reduce repetitive work and improve access to usable information.
  • Build dashboards and visual outputs that help communicate trends, performance indicators and operational insights.
  • Support capacity building by training and guiding health information officers in data workflows and system use.

Reported in the CV under the District Quality Improvement Manager role, USAID Quality 4 Health (Q4H), 2023–Present. This is a professional quality-improvement result and is not attributed to any single portfolio project.

Featured Project ★ Open Source

DHIMS2 Monthly Dataset Auto-Complete

A Python script that interfaces with the DHIMS2 REST API to automatically mark all health facility datasets as complete for the previous month — across every facility in a district. Replaces hours of manual clicking with a single double-click.

Power BI · Analytics ★ New

Healthcare Intelligence: Insights from Advanced Analytics

A multi-page Power BI dashboard delivering healthcare intelligence across four analytical domains — Medical, Patients, Financials and Admissions. It brings key indicators, trends and operational views into an interactive reporting experience using data modelling, DAX measures and visual analytics.

ChallengeComplex healthcare datasets can be difficult to explore through disconnected reports.
ApproachOrganise information into linked analytical views with measures and interactive visuals.
ValueA consolidated view to support exploration of patient, clinical and financial patterns.
Measured dashboard outputs and efficiency gains
30+healthcare KPIs tracked
20+dashboard users

Geospatial · GIS Analysis ★ New

Spatial Distribution of Hospitals Across Ghana

A national-level map overlaying Ghana's land cover with the geolocation of every hospital and polyclinic by region — surfacing how healthcare access is skewed toward the southern and central regions versus the north. Built to support planning conversations around facility siting and equity.
